description: This file defines the JpGraph class within the PhpSpreadsheet chart renderer namespace, which manages loading external JpGraph modules required for chart rendering. It includes a static initialization method that loads various JpGraph modules if they haven't been loaded already.

classes.name: JpGraph
classes.description: Handles loading and initializing the JpGraph library modules for chart rendering within PhpSpreadsheet, ensuring modules are loaded only once.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the JpGraph modules needed for chart rendering by calling static methods on JpGraph\JpGraph if not already loaded.
